title: Review on progress of rare earth molecule-based functional materials in 2025
claim: Spontaneous symmetry breaking through π–π and C–H···π contacts can resolve an achiral europium complex into homochiral aggregates more effectively than conventional chiral resolution.
explanation: The review contrasts low-efficiency conventional resolution with symmetry-breaking self-assembly. Intermolecular π–π and C–H···π interactions drive achiral EuNTA into purely Λ or Δ chiral aggregates. A related amino-acid induction route asymmetrically assembles achiral octahedral lanthanide cages.
scope: Achiral lanthanide complexes and cages that crystallize or assemble through directional noncovalent contacts or chiral additives.
conditions: Spontaneous assembly of EuNTA; amino-acid chiral induction for octahedral cages.
caveats: The superiority claim is qualitative and demonstrated on EuNTA rather than shown to be general for all achiral lanthanide complexes.
